description: Given a business website domain, returns the business name and the page element it came from, the published contact surface, and the technology platforms the site runs (analytics, tag managers, email marketing, SEO tools and more), each with the evidence it was detected from. Every claim is checked against its evidence and unsupported ones are struck on Agent Harbor's own hardware. Faster, cheaper tier than /enrich. Not charged if the page cannot be used. Free prompt-injection scan included. Costs $0.01 USDC per successful call (x402, eip155:8453); failures are not charged.
